Interface CodecFactory

All Known Implementing Classes:
ForyCodecFactory, GsonCodecFactory, Jackson2CodecFactory, JacksonCodecFactory, JsonbCodecFactory, ProtobufCodecFactory
public interface CodecFactory
Produces Codec instances for arbitrary types, backed by a serialization library.
